panels.rationale: The image is a histological slide of removed tissue confirmed to be a paraffinoma, specifically showing characteristic empty oil vacuoles (paraffin vacuoles) and associated lymphocytic/histiocytic inflammation, matching the primary disease key.
panels.attribution_text: Cormio et al. Magnetic resonance imaging of penile paraffinoma: case report.. BMC medical imaging 2014. doi:10.1186/1471-2342-14-39. CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Figure 4.
panels.figure_caption: Histological image of the removed tissue showing optical empty spaces indicative of the presence of large fat globules dissolved during the staining process, along with a heavy inflammation mainly consisting of lymphocytes and histiocytes, throughout the whole specimen.
